**README.md**

```
# Stroop-anxiety — data and code

Does trait anxiety increase Stroop
interference? 100 adults completed a 
colour-word Stroop task (PsychoPy, March 2026). 
We investigated the impact of trait anxiety 
on Stroop task performance in terms of 
reaction times and accuracy.

## Files
- data/stroop_data.csv — trial-level data
- data/stroop_dictionary.csv — data descrption
- scripts/01_preprocessing.R — cleans data
- scripts/02_analysis.R — runs the analysis

## Reproduce
Run 01 then 02 in R (>= 4.3).

## License
Data CC0-1.0, code GPL-3.0 (see LICENSE).

```
